bootstrap.summary: A calibrated seed pair and 16 further camera(s) were accepted.

warnings: No adjacent frame pair of frames 1–18 passed every seed gate, so their calibrated seed pair spans frames 9–15 (6 sampling intervals): matches composed along the tracked links and refined to sub-pixel positions leave 2.60 px after the best pure rotation (requires more than 1.25 px), and the pair passed every two-view gate with a 8.17° median triangulation angle. 16 further frame(s) of that span became registration keyframes.
Most frame pairs have weak residual parallax after compensating dominant translation and rotation. Move through a textured scene instead of only panning or rotating the camera.

Slice 4 dense point fusion accepted 9046 fused scene points from reference frame 6 using 9 registered source views and 24 inverse-depth hypotheses. 4455 primary candidates passed reciprocal depth consistency; spatial fusion rejected 15 reverse observations. Fused points remain separate from the sparse map; dense coverage is bounded to accepted reference patches and does not claim unbounded aggregation or metric scale.

Slice 4 bounded mesh reconstruction accepted 8651 triangles from 15618 candidate triangles across 10050 reference-grid cells. It rejected 201 triangles at depth/spatial discontinuities and 0 degenerate or orientation-flipped triangles. This is a bounded multi-reference, non-watertight surface preview. Browser texture projection is appearance-only over accepted per-reference topology; unsupported holes and metric scale are not claimed.

Bounded non-adjacent revisit screening found 12 strong keyframe-pair candidates and produced recovery or registered-pose closure attempts, but no additional revisit-driven geometry survived the deterministic PnP, bounded-drift, and bundle-adjustment no-regression gates. No camera pose was invented or half-integrated from revisit evidence.

Slice 3 registered 16 additional selected keyframes, including 0 recovered from bounded direct revisit evidence, triangulated 813 new landmarks, retained 0 seed-anchored loop corrections, and accepted deterministic bundle adjustment across 16 cameras, 928 landmarks, and 5005 supported observations. Reprojection RMSE improved from 0.48 px to 0.29 px while the calibrated seed-pair cameras remained fixed to preserve the arbitrary monocular gauge. No metric-scale claim or arbitrary non-seed pose-graph optimization is made.

Cross-reference surface fusion aligned 579 mutually nearest seam vertex pairs across 3 validated camera-support groups (2144 bounded cross-group candidates considered; 953 rejected for surface-normal disagreement and 442 because the complete proposed seam move set would weaken accepted triangle topology). No vertices or triangles were fabricated.

Overlapping reference patches: 460 fused seam pair(s) became shared vertices (44 shared vertices, 702 cross-reference triangles) and 119 kept separate vertices because their endpoints carry different evidence origins; 7568 duplicated overlap triangle(s) were dropped in favour of the patch already meshing that surface, 1013 of them seam triangles owned only in part, trimming 0.20% of the accepted mesh area; 91 seam stitch triangle(s) over existing vertices closed the gaps trimmed seams left, only where the removed triangles observed the surface at the owner's depth; and 611 partially overlapping triangle(s) were retained to preserve supported geometry. 0 linked patch pair(s) had too few anchored overlap samples to calibrate their relative depth scale and were compared uncalibrated. 5 candidate lookup(s) hit the posting bound of 512 owner triangles (at most 512 processed by one lookup) and 0 triangle(s) exhausted the clipping budget of 128 fragments; both were retained unjudged. 3 of 3 camera-support group(s) carry triangles, forming 1 connected patch component(s). 222 partially owned overlap triangle(s) were clipped against their owner at the same depth into 428 remainder triangle(s), deriving 349 vertex(es) on owner edges with source-triangle and barycentric lineage (derived geometry, not new observations) and splitting 282 triangle(s) at them so no vertex lies inside another edge; 389 could not be clipped verifiably and were kept whole. Only fusion-accepted pairs were merged; no observed vertex was created or moved, and gaps no patch observed stay open.

Provider-neutral reconstruction evidence v2 validated for video-to-3d-core/classic: 18 accepted cameras, 6 provenance regions, 9395 shared dense points (4455 geometric, 4591 revalidated completion, 0 learned, 0 generative completion), and 8651 accepted triangles; it carries per-point reciprocal-consistency and depth-margin attributes. 57 merged triangle(s) keep their pre-canonicalization reference corners. 349 point(s) were derived on observed source triangles where overlap seams were clipped; they carry source-triangle and barycentric lineage and are not counted as observations. The evidence view borrows the existing geometry buffers instead of materializing a second point cloud or mesh.

Geometry confidence v2: 6 regions (4 high, 2 medium, 0 low, 0 unsupported) from camera support, reprojection, reciprocal agreement, depth ambiguity, triangulation and reference exclusivity; confidence 0.56-0.75; 6 regions score reciprocal agreement 1.00-1.00 and depth ambiguity 0.34-0.45 separately from per-point attributes; triangles 0 high, 196 medium, 8455 low, 0 unsupported. Areas without accepted points carry no confidence.

Coarse collider v1: 184 boxes (915 grid cells of 0.222) from 3994 of 8651 accepted triangles; excluded 0 learned/generative and 4657 below confidence 0.15. Kept separate from the visual mesh, at most 0.385 beyond the accepted surface; unsupported holes stay open.
